issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect a Course initializer with the parameter order (name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]) and show an example call using those labels in that order. The solution's Course initializer declares parameters in a different order (instructor: String, name: String, ratings: [Int]). This mismatch in constructor parameter ordering across artifacts can confuse students who compare the template/problem example with the solution implementation or when reading the reference; it is a structural inconsistency in the API design.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter ordering consistent. Update the solution's Course initializer to use init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]) (matching the example in the problem statement and the template) or, if the intended design is to have instructor first, update the problem statement and template to show the instructor-first signature and example. Ensure Client calls and all references use the same parameter labels and order.
